goal.en: Talk about life experience with the present perfect, and use the phrasal verbs English speakers really use.
goal.ar: أن تتحدث عن خبراتك بالمضارع التام، وأن تستخدم الأفعال المركّبة الشائعة فعلاً.

text.en: have/has + past participle (the third form): I have visited Rome. She has finished her work.
text.ar: have/has مع التصريف الثالث للفعل: I have visited Rome / She has finished her work.

text.en: It links the past to now: the action happened at some time before now, and the exact time is not important.
text.ar: يربط الماضي بالحاضر: وقع الفعل في وقت ما قبل الآن، ولا يهمّنا تحديد وقته.

text.en: With a finished past time (yesterday, in 2020, last week) you must use the past simple: “I saw him yesterday”, not “I have seen him yesterday”.
text.ar: إذا ذُكر زمن ماضٍ منتهٍ مثل yesterday أو last week وجب استخدام الماضي البسيط: I saw him yesterday وليس I have seen him yesterday.

title.ar: ever و never و already و yet

head: Word
Use
Example
rows: Have you ever been to Turkey?
questions and negatives, at the end
Have you finished yet? / I haven't finished yet.

text.en: “Been to” = went and came back. “Gone to” = went and is still there.
text.ar: been to تعني أنه ذهب وعاد، أما gone to فتعني أنه ذهب ولا يزال هناك.

text.en: A phrasal verb is a verb + a small word that together mean something new. Guessing from the parts rarely works — learn them as units.
text.ar: الفعل المركّب هو فعل مع حرف صغير يكوّنان معاً معنى جديداً. ونادراً ما ينفع تخمين المعنى من الأجزاء، فاحفظه كوحدة.

explanation.ar: مع I نستخدم have مع التصريف الثالث.

options: I have seen that film twice.

explanation.en: “Yesterday” is a finished past time, so the past simple is required: I saw him yesterday.
explanation.ar: كلمة yesterday زمن ماضٍ منتهٍ، فيلزم الماضي البسيط: I saw him yesterday.

commonMistake.en: The present perfect cannot appear with a specific finished time. That single rule prevents most errors.
commonMistake.ar: المضارع التام لا يجتمع مع زمن ماضٍ محدد منتهٍ، وهذه القاعدة وحدها تمنع أغلب الأخطاء.

explanation.ar: تصريفات الفعل: write ثم wrote ثم written.

questions.sentence: They ___ the new office in Dubai.

explanation.ar: مع they نستخدم have مع التصريف الثالث opened.

explanation.en: “Ever” asks about any time in your life.
explanation.ar: ever تسأل عن أي وقت في حياتك.

explanation.en: “Yet” goes at the end of negatives and questions.
explanation.ar: تأتي yet في نهاية الجملة المنفية أو السؤال.

questions.sentence: Don't cook for me — I've ___ eaten.

explanation.en: “Already” means sooner than expected, and sits before the participle.
explanation.ar: already تعني «سلفاً/قبل الموعد المتوقع»، وموضعها قبل التصريف الثالث.

prompt.en: “He has gone to the bank.” Where is he now?
prompt.ar: «He has gone to the bank» أين هو الآن؟

explanation.en: “Has gone” = he went and is still there. “Has been” would mean he went and came back.
explanation.ar: has gone تعني أنه ذهب ولا يزال هناك، ولو قلنا has been لدلّت على أنه ذهب وعاد.
Have ثم الفاعل ثم ever ثم التصريف الثالث.

questions.sentence: Please ___ the TV — I'm trying to study.
I've been ___ my passport all morning.

explanation.en: look for = search for. “Look after” means take care of.
explanation.ar: look for تعني البحث عن، أما look after فتعني الاعتناء بـ.

prompt.en: Match the phrasal verb with its meaning.

explanation.en: The particle changes the meaning completely — always learn the pair together.
explanation.ar: الحرف التابع يغيّر المعنى تماماً، فاحفظ الفعل مع حرفه.

options: Don't give up — you're nearly there.
Don't give up you, you are near.
Don't up give, you are nearly there.
Don't give up it the exam now.

explanation.en: “Give up” here has no object and cannot be split.
explanation.ar: الفعل give up هنا بلا مفعول، ولا يجوز الفصل بين جزأيه.

questions.sentence: I ___ in Kuwait for two years, and I'm still here.

explanation.en: The situation started in the past and continues now → present perfect.
explanation.ar: الوضع بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمراً حتى الآن، فنستخدم المضارع التام.

options: Have you finished the report yet?
She hasn't called me back yet.

explanation.en: “Already” and “yet” cannot be used together: “I have already finished.”
explanation.ar: لا تجتمع already مع yet في جملة واحدة. الصواب I have already finished.
